prompt_contract.source_caption: At source frame 0, the same woman in the black floral blouse holds the upper-left white ceramic pouring vessel #1 over the center-right transparent handled glass vessel #2, while the lower-left small white ceramic teacup #3 remains on its saucer and idle. All three original vessels, their materials, colors, the table, lighting, framing, and camera belong only to the source video.
prompt_contract.target_caption: The same source woman first stops the upper-left white ceramic vessel #1 from pouring into the center-right transparent handled glass vessel #2 and returns #1 upright. She then lifts that same transparent glass vessel #2, pours a continuous amber stream from #2 into the lower-left small white ceramic teacup #3 on its saucer until #3 visibly fills, stops the stream, returns #2 upright, and holds. Preserve all three source vessels; #2 must remain transparent and must never become a white or opaque vessel.
prompt_contract.source_noop_caption: Keep the exact source frame-0 state and all three source vessels unchanged. Do not continue or complete a pour, do not lift object #2, do not pour object #2 into object #3, and do not change any vessel identity, material, color, count, or position.
prompt_contract.editing_instruction: Use the source video as the sole authority for identity, appearance, object instances, material, color, scene, lighting, framing, camera, and initial state. Frame 0 must exactly retain the source state: the upper-left white ceramic pouring vessel (#1) remains in its original held pose over the center-right transparent handled glass vessel (#2), and the lower-left small white ceramic teacup on its saucer (#3) remains idle; do not pre-apply the requested role switch. Immediately after frame 0, stop any ongoing pour from #1 into #2, return #1 upright, and keep #1 unchanged and stationary. Then grasp and lift that same original transparent handled glass vessel #2, keep it transparent, align its mouth over the same original small white teacup #3, tilt #2, and pour a clearly visible continuous amber stream from #2 into #3 until the liquid level in #3 visibly rises. Stop the stream, return #2 upright, and hold #2 upright beside the filled #3 in a stable terminal state. Preserve exactly the same woman and all three original vessels throughout. Do not use #1 as the edited pouring actor after it is returned upright. Do not replace, recolor, merge, duplicate, remove, or introduce any vessel; do not turn #2 into a white or opaque vessel; and do not copy any person, vessel, clothing, table, or background appearance from the action anchor. Use one continuous 81-frame video at 25 fps with no cuts, teleportation, morphing, or disappearing contact.
